chunks: And the one who prostrates in Makkah is like one covered in his own blood in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.بِدَمِهِ: in his own blood, indicating utmost sacrifice
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic, an honorific for Allah
key_terms.فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: in the way of Allah, meaning for His cause
key_terms.كَالْمُتَشَحِّطِ: like one rolling or covered over

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of performing sajdah in Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith exalts the virtue of sajdah in Makkah by likening it to the immense sacrifice of one who sheds blood in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. It emphasizes the elevated spiritual rank of worship performed in the sacred sanctuary.
